description: This file defines a custom logger class 'DeepEvalLogger' for integrating LiteLLM with DeepEval's platform, handling the logging of success and failure events related to language model traces and interactions with DeepEval API endpoints.

classes.name: DeepEvalLogger
classes.description: A custom logger class for logging LiteLLM traces to DeepEval's platform, with methods for logging success and failure events both synchronously and asynchronously.

methods.name: __init__(self, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the DeepEvalLogger, retrieves environment variables, validates environment, and creates an Api instance.

methods.name: log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a successful event to DeepEval's platform.

methods.name: log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a failed event to DeepEval's platform.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a failed event to DeepEval's platform.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a successful event to DeepEval's platform.

methods.name: _prepare_trace_api( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time, is_success )
methods.description: Prepares the API payload/body for trace data, including timestamps, status, output, and request details.

methods.name: _sync_event_handler( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time, is_success )
methods.description: Handles the synchronous sending of trace event data to DeepEval API.

methods.name: _async_event_handler( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time, is_success )
methods.description: Handles the asynchronous sending of trace event data to DeepEval API.

methods.name: _create_base_api_span( self, kwargs, standard_logging_object, start_time, end_time, is_success )
methods.description: Constructs the base span object with trace metadata, output, and tokens.

methods.name: _create_trace_api( self, base_api_span, standard_logging_object, start_time, end_time, litellm_environment, )
methods.description: Creates the full trace API object containing span information and environment data.
